prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions generally overestimate noise-corrected results, though winning tests frequently exceed expectations.
No clear effect was seen for choose_path hints across three tests or home notifications across two tests.
adoption layout changes showed no clear effect or degraded performance across two tests.

Evidence remains inconsistent for sign_in copy, sign_in reorder, adoption redesign, adoption new_screen, choose_path layout, finish hint, and finish redesign due to mixed outcomes.
Evidence remains thin for change kinds tested only once, including sign_in redesign, finish new_screen, and adoption new_flow.

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] Interactive pet mood preview stage: Add a new pet mood preview screen after picking a friend to let users test emotional reactions before finalizing adoption. (why: Support emails report custom pet issues and users take a median 89s / mean 1017s during adoption; mood previewing establishes clear expectations early.)
1: [home, redesign] Stage layout for waiting screen: Redesign the waiting screen into a stage layout featuring a animated pet mascot and prominent progress status. (why: Users spend a median of 201s and mean of 2336s waiting, and 3 support emails report pet rendering failures on desktop.)
2: [sign_in, redesign] Two-column login layout with pet safety guarantee: Redesign the sign-in screen into a two-column layout showing login options alongside a pet account persistence guarantee. (why: 8 support emails complain about pets missing or reset after signing in again, making account recovery assurance critical.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Account persistence clarification headline: Update the sign-in screen headline and body text to explicitly mention retrieving existing pet profiles. (why: The single largest support issue (8 emails) involves pets missing after sign-in; explicit login copy helps users reconnect existing pets.)
4: [finish, layout] Checklist layout for home introduction: Switch the home introduction layout to a structured checklist guiding users through essential desktop controls. (why: 3 support tickets cite post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control or hide the pet, while finish conversion is 76.6%.)
5: [home, wait_info] Background desktop preparation tips on waiting screen: Display rotating preparation status hints on the waiting screen to inform users what engine assets are being loaded. (why: The home waiting step has a long mean duration of 2336s; progress hints maintain user engagement while loading.)
6: [finish, incentive] Desktop pet interaction welcome badge: Display an achievement badge on the home intro screen celebrating the completion of pet setup. (why: Completion drops to 76.6% on the finish step; adding a rewarding milestone badge boosts final step completion.)
7: [choose_path, hint] Path setup recommendation hint: Add a reassuring hint on the story screen noting that all pet behavior settings can be customized later. (why: choose_path has a high mean time of 514s; clarifying that choices aren't permanent reduces decision friction.)
8: [home, notification] Desktop render completion audio cue: Enable an audio sound cue and completion trigger on the waiting screen when the pet renders on desktop. (why: Users wait a median of 201s on the waiting screen and often tab away; an audio cue alerts them when their pet is ready.)
